comment: nodemon by default watches ALL files in the server directory, including
are written at runtime by fileStorage.js on every login / register /
logout call. Without ignoring them, nodemon detects each write and
restarts the process — causing the startup logs to repeat in a loop.
The 'ignore' list below prevents those runtime-written files from
triggering restarts. Only actual source-code changes (*.js, *.mjs,
*.json config files at the root) will cause a restart.
